cases.description: Genuine synthetic Indian passport (matching mock registry record)
Genuine synthetic Nepal visa with passport and Kakarbhitta arrival stamp (third-country traveller)
Genuine synthetic Indian driving licence (signed QR, yellow/gold visual feature, mock registry VALID)
Genuine synthetic Bhutan entry permit (signed QR, mock registry ISSUED)
Synthetic Aadhaar-like card: must route to official verification, never self-verify
OCR/MRZ mismatch: printed passport number differs from MRZ
Passport/visa mismatch: visa quotes a different passport number
DOB mismatch: printed DOB differs from the (mock) registry record
Expired document
QR/OCR mismatch: unsigned QR DOB differs from printed DOB
Missing QR on a template version that carries one
Stamp detection: Nepal immigration arrival stamp, Kakarbhitta
Unknown stamp: impression with no identifiable authority, checkpoint or direction
Land-border checkpoint match: Birgunj (India–Nepal) arrival stamp
Checkpoint mismatch: stamp says NEPAL immigration but names an Indian (India–Bhutan) post
Synthetic photo replacement: portrait swapped with a re-compressed, noisier photo
Image manipulation: DOB text region overwritten with a pasted, re-compressed patch
Registry unavailable: genuine licence, DL registry disabled
Poor-quality image: blurred, dark, low resolution
Offline verification: genuine passport verified with no connectivity
Name mismatch: printed surname differs from MRZ
Expiry mismatch: printed expiry differs from MRZ
MRZ mismatch: DOB check digit does not validate
Photo-position anomaly: portrait printed where the template expects text
Face mismatch: presented person differs from the passport photo
Face match control: presented person is the passport holder (different capture)
Stamp-reference mismatch: Kakarbhitta arrival stamp with geometry unlike its (synthetic) reference
Stamp image-forensics anomaly: stamp pasted as a re-compressed patch and duplicated
Digital-signature failure: signed QR data altered after signing
Unregistered document: well-formed licence with no record in the mock registry
Multiple simultaneous inconsistencies: expired + MRZ check digit + DOB mismatch
India–Nepal treaty national: Indian passport, no visa/stamp — must NOT be flagged
India–Nepal third-country national without the required Nepal visa
India–Bhutan (post-2022 rules): Indian passport, no physical stamp — must NOT be flagged
Modified nationality: document says NEPALI, the (mock) registry record says INDIAN
Damaged/unreadable QR: part of the code is covered
Missing MRZ on a passport data page
Missing photo: licence with an empty photo area
Low-quality live face capture: blurred, dark, tiny — retake, not a mismatch
Stamp date inconsistency: entry stamped before the visa's validity began
Unexpected checkpoint: foreigner stamped at a post not designated for foreigners
Indian immigration marking (Raxaul) identified from text + checkpoint reference
Bhutan immigration marking (Phuentsholing) identified from text + checkpoint reference
Live face matches the document, but the authorised reference photo shows someone else
Cropped document: right side and part of the MRZ outside the frame
Visual signature only: an image of a signature is not treated as a digital signature

face_pairs.note: 12 drawn synthetic identities: 12 same-person pairs, 66 different-person pairs; positive = 'no match'. Drawn faces are NOT representative of real photographs.
